evidence.exact_quote: At least 68 people have been killed after two high-speed trains collided near Toledo, Spain, Castilla-La Mancha regional President Emiliano Garcia-Page has said, according to Spanish newspaper ABC.
Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has announced three days of national mourning and pledged a thorough investigation into the disaster.

framing_claims.text: RT destaca la magnitud del desastre con un título sensacionalista y menciona videos, subrayando el elevado número de muertos y la respuesta del gobierno.
